Can phones and laptops be shipped by air?
Yes. Devices with batteries installed (UN3481) are commonly accepted within quantity limits. Loose batteries (UN3480) are cargo-aircraft only and must ship at no more than 30% charge.
What is a safety data sheet (SDS)?
A document from the manufacturer describing a product's hazards. We need it to classify your goods correctly. It is sometimes called an MSDS.
Can you ship perfumes and paints?
Yes. Most are Class 3 flammable liquids and can move by air or sea with the right packaging, labels and declaration.
What happens if goods are declared wrongly?
Carriers can refuse, offload or fine undeclared or misdeclared dangerous goods. That is why we classify before booking, not after.
